procedural_matters: GER 57279 was represented by Charlotte Conrad (helm).
The International Jury was represented by Joao Carneiro (member of the International Jury).
Lena Gödicke (crew of GER 5729) and Bruno Lemaitre (member of the International Jury) attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: During race 4, flag O was not displayed.

Four seconds before the starting signal, GER 57279 was penalized by two members of the International Jury for breaking RRS 42.2(b) (rocking) by making a sound signal with the whistle, pointing a Yellow flag at her and hailing her sail number.
After taking the Two-Turns Penalty, the helm of GER 57279 asked the members of the International Jury that signaled the penalty if she had to retire after a second yellow flag, which they confirmed.
GER 57279 thereafter left the race course.
GER 57279 was scored DNE in race 4.
conclusions: There was no failure by a member of the International Jury to take into account a race committee signal or class rule. Therefore, the redress limitation under RRS P4 applies.

GER 57279 failed to promptly retire after she was penalized the second time during the event and was therefore correctly scored DNE in race 4 under RRS P2.2. Hence, there was no improper action or improper omission of the International Jury. Therefore, the requirements for redress under RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
